items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 for demanding technical work
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic發布Claude Fable 5.2與Mythos 5.2，專攻高難度技術工作
items_flat.summary_en: On November 9, Anthropic introduced Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 as the same underlying model, with stronger safeguards on Fable. The models improve coding, reasoning, and vision while generating outputs up to 30% faster than 5.1 at a lower price of $8/$40 per million tokens, and formalized Fermat’s Last Theorem in 30 hours during testing.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月9日，Anthropic推出Claude Fable 5.2與Claude Mythos 5.2，兩者為同一底層模型，Fable強化安全防護。模型在編碼、推理與視覺上提升，輸出速度比5.1快最多30%，價格降至每百萬token 8/40美元，測試中30小時內形式化費馬最後定理。
items_flat.analysis_en: The dual-release structure lets Anthropic ship high capability while gating the highest-risk domains. Benchmark gains on agentic coding and science tasks are large relative to 5.1, but independent verification of the multi-day agent runs remains limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 雙版本結構讓Anthropic在釋出高能力的同時，對最高風險領域設限。相較5.1，在agentic編碼與科學任務的基準提升明顯，但多日agent運行的獨立驗證仍有限。
items_flat.quote: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision. ... They generate outputs up to 30% faster than Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, and they’re available at a lower price: $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude Fable 5.2與Claude Mythos 5.2在編碼、推理與視覺等領域有所提升。……它們產出輸出的速度比Claude Fable 5.1與Claude Mythos 5.1快最多30%，且價格更低：每百萬輸入token 8美元、每百萬輸出token 40美元。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT Wallet for secure agent payments
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT Wallet，讓代理安全完成付款
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Wallet on November 13, enabling AI agents (dots) to complete purchases without accessing users’ actual card details. Every transaction requires user approval with a security check such as biometrics; initial rollout is for US Pro subscribers using major card networks.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月13日宣布推出ChatGPT Wallet，讓AI代理（dots）無需取得用戶實際卡號即可完成購買。每筆交易都需用戶批准並進行生物辨識等安全檢查；初期對美國Pro訂戶開放，支援主要卡組織。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves agentic commerce from research demos into a controlled production path that preserves existing card rails and user control. Success still depends on merchant adoption and risk-system performance outside early beta.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將代理商務從研究示範推進到受控的生產路徑，同時保留既有卡組織軌道與用戶控制。成功與否仍取決於商家採用度與早期測試外的風險系統表現。
items_flat.quote: ChatGPT Wallet helps your dot go from finding what you need to making a purchase on your behalf.
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT Wallet幫助你的dot從找到你需要的東西，到代你完成購買。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for faster everyday agentic workflows
items_flat.title_zh: Google推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，加速日常agentic工作流程
items_flat.summary_en: On November 12, Google DeepMind and Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, positioned as a fast, efficient model for coding and agentic workflows rather than the deepest long-horizon reasoning of Carbon or Argon. It is available across Gemini surfaces at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens with a 1M context window and claims 2.5× speed over 3.8 Flash.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月12日，Google DeepMind與Google推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，定位為編碼與agentic工作流程的快速高效模型，而非Carbon或Argon的最深長時推理。它已在Gemini各表面開放，價格每百萬token 1.50/7.50美元，1M上下文，宣稱比3.8 Flash快2.5倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: Hydrogen broadens Gemini 4 access at a lower price point while claiming speed and efficiency gains over 3.8 Flash. It does not displace the higher-capability Carbon/Argon tier.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Hydrogen以較低價格擴大Gemini 4的可及性，並宣稱在速度與效率上優於3.8 Flash。它並未取代更高能力的Carbon/Argon層級。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，將前沿智能帶給所有人——以速度與效率支援日常編碼與agentic工作流程。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 for improved real-world dexterity
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind推出Gemini Robotics 2.5，提升真實世界靈巧度
items_flat.summary_en: On November 10, Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action model that expands task breadth and learning speed. In a Mercedes-Benz proof-of-concept, Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid achieved a reported 96% success rate on automotive parts kitting.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月10日，Google DeepMind發布Gemini Robotics 2.5，這是擴展任務廣度與學習速度的視覺-語言-動作模型。在Mercedes-Benz概念驗證中，Apptronik的Apollo 2人形機器人在汽車零件組裝上報導達96%成功率。
items_flat.analysis_en: The industrial pilot supplies a concrete reliability signal beyond lab benchmarks, yet the 96% figure is vendor-reported on a narrow workflow. Broader generalization and safety in unstructured settings remain open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 工業試點提供了超出實驗室基準的具體可靠性訊號，但96%數字是供應商在狹窄工作流程上的報導。更廣泛的泛化與非結構化環境安全性仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: During a real-world proof-of-concept on Mercedes-Benz production lines, our models helped Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid pick and pack automotive parts with a 96% success rate.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在Mercedes-Benz生產線的真實概念驗證中，我們的模型幫助Apptronik的Apollo 2人形機器人揀選與包裝汽車零件，成功率達96%。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed IPO
items_flat.summary_en: On November 10, Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of Class A common stock. The company had previously filed a Form S-1 with the SEC; the offering contemplates roughly 825 million shares at an expected price range of $70–$78, targeting a Nasdaq listing under ANT.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月10日，Anthropic, PBC啟動其擬議首次公開發行Class A普通股的路演。公司先前已向SEC提交Form S-1；發行約8.25億股，預期價格區間70–78美元，目標在Nasdaq以ANT代號上市。
items_flat.analysis_en: The roadshow advances Anthropic’s transition from private lab to public company while it continues to ship frontier models. Market reception and any conditions attached to the offering remain the key open variables.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 路演推進Anthropic從私人實驗室轉向上市公司，同時持續發布前沿模型。市場反應與發行附帶的任何條件仍是關鍵變數。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock. The proposed offering consists of 825,000,000 shares of Class A common stock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天Anthropic, PBC啟動其擬議首次公開發行Class A普通股的路演。擬議發行包括8.25億股Class A普通股。

items_flat.title_en: Google Research opens Antigravity /teamwork multi-agent tools and reports Lean formalizations of major math results
items_flat.title_zh: Google Research開放Antigravity /teamwork多代理工具，並報告重大數學結果的Lean形式化
items_flat.summary_en: On November 13, Google Research described results from Antigravity’s /teamwork multi-agent workflows using Gemini 4 models, including claimed machine-checked formalizations such as a full proof of the Courtade–Kumar conjecture and large Lean outputs.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月13日，Google Research描述了使用Gemini 4模型的Antigravity /teamwork多代理工作流程結果，包括聲稱的機器檢查形式化，如Courtade–Kumar猜想的完整證明與大型Lean輸出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Opening multi-agent research orchestration to outsiders accelerates independent scrutiny of the claimed formalizations. The scale of the Lean outputs is notable, but independent verification is still required.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 向外部開放多代理研究編排，加速對所聲稱形式化的獨立審查。Lean輸出的規模值得注意，但仍需獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: External scientists and developers can use Gemini 4 models with /teamwork and /boost in Antigravity and Deep Review today.
items_flat.quote_zh: 外部科學家與開發者今日即可在 Antigravity 與 Deep Review 中使用 Gemini 4 模型搭配 /teamwork 與 /boost。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic makes Claude Opus 5.5 the default model on paid plans and publishes knowledge-work guide
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic將Claude Opus 5.5設為付費方案預設模型並發布知識工作指南
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic set Claude Opus 5.5 as the default model on Pro, Max, Ultra, and Team plans and published a guide recommending it for daily knowledge work. The guide advises dropping phrases such as “think hard,” starting at Medium effort, and describing the desired outcome rather than the process.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic將Claude Opus 5.5設為Pro、Max、Ultra與Team方案的預設模型，並發布指南建議用於日常知識工作。指南建議捨棄「think hard」等用語，從Medium effort開始，並描述期望結果而非過程。
items_flat.analysis_en: Making a stronger model the default lowers the barrier for most users while the prompting guidance aims to avoid habits that under-use adaptive thinking. Whether the higher per-token cost is offset in practice is still early.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將更強模型設為預設降低大多數用戶門檻，而提示指引旨在避免低估適應性思考的習慣。更高每token成本是否在實務中被抵消仍早。
items_flat.quote: Claude Opus 5.5 is now the default model in Claude on Pro, Max, Ultra, and Team plans. We recommend it as your daily driver for knowledge work.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude Opus 5.5 現在是 Claude 在 Pro、Max、Ultra 與 Team 方案上的預設模型。我們推薦它作為知識工作的日常主力。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic adds experimental Code Mode to Claude Code for multi-tool calls in JavaScript
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic為Claude Code新增實驗性Code Mode，以JavaScript一次發出多工具呼叫
items_flat.summary_en: Claude Code v2.1.323 introduced experimental Code Mode, in which Claude writes JavaScript that issues multiple tool calls (Bash, Read, Edit, etc.) in one step and returns only the needed results. It is off by default and can be enabled via configuration.
items_flat.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.323引入實驗性Code Mode，Claude可撰寫JavaScript一次發出多個工具呼叫（Bash、Read、Edit等）並只回傳所需結果。預設關閉，可透過設定啟用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Code Mode targets the token cost of sequential tool calling, which is a practical bottleneck for long agentic sessions. Its experimental status and restrictions on certain features mean adoption will be gradual.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Code Mode針對順序工具呼叫的token成本，這是長時agentic會話的實務瓶頸。其實驗狀態與某些功能限制意味採用將逐步進行。
items_flat.quote: With Code Mode, Claude writes a piece of JavaScript that makes the tool calls, and Claude Code runs that code in your session.
items_flat.quote_zh: 啟用 Code Mode 後，Claude 會撰寫一段進行工具呼叫的 JavaScript，並由 Claude Code 在您的工作階段中執行該程式碼。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic publishes 10 recommendations for designing and reporting AI safety evaluations
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic發布設計與報告AI安全評估的10項建議
items_flat.summary_en: On November 13, Anthropic posted “Building Strong Safety Evaluations” on its engineering/research blog, offering 10 recommendations for how labs design, run, and report the evaluations that inform deployment and safeguard decisions.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月13日，Anthropic在其工程/研究部落格發表「Building Strong Safety Evaluations」，提出10項建議，說明實驗室應如何設計、執行與報告影響部署與安全防護決策的評估。
items_flat.analysis_en: Public recommendations raise the floor for evaluation quality across the industry, especially around preregistration and multi-turn testing. Whether other labs adopt them in practice is uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 公開建議提升產業評估品質的下限，尤其在預註冊與多輪測試方面。其他實驗室是否實務採用仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Safety evaluations inform some of the most consequential decisions we make about an AI model, including whether it’s ready to deploy, which safeguards ship alongside it, and what our next round of safety training and research should focus on.
items_flat.quote_zh: 安全評估影響我們對 AI 模型所做的一些最關鍵決定，包括是否準備好部署、隨之附帶哪些安全護欄，以及下一輪安全訓練與研究應聚焦何處。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI reorganizes stand-alone robotics team into core research and Applied
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI將獨立機器人團隊重組進核心研究與Applied
items_flat.summary_en: On November 13, OpenAI confirmed to Fortune that it has reorganized its stand-alone robotics team. Research staff now report to Chief Research Officer Mark Chen; applied robotics and hardware teams moved under President Greg Brockman’s Applied organization.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月13日，OpenAI向Fortune確認已重組其獨立機器人團隊。研究人員現向首席研究官Mark Chen報告；應用機器人與硬體團隊移至總裁Greg Brockman的Applied組織下。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move signals a strategic bet that frontier general models can reduce the need for specialized robotics teams, echoing OpenAI’s 2020 pause and 2024 restart. It is not framed as a full exit from robotics.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉顯示策略押注前沿通用模型可減少專門機器人團隊的需求，呼應OpenAI 2020年暫停與2024年重啟。並未被框架為完全退出機器人領域。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind releases PARDIG and SatWeave weather datasets
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind發布PARDIG與SatWeave天氣數據集
items_flat.summary_en: On November 13, Google DeepMind released two foundational datasets used by WeatherNext 3: SatWeave (a global mosaic of geostationary satellite imagery) and PARDIG (an AI-based global precipitation dataset). Historical archives and live feeds are available.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月13日，Google DeepMind發布WeatherNext 3使用的兩個基礎數據集：SatWeave（地球靜止衛星影像全球拼接）與PARDIG（基於AI的全球降水數據集）。歷史檔案與即時饋送皆可用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Open observational datasets lower the barrier for third parties to build on DeepMind’s weather stack. Independent validation of the claimed precipitation-skill gains will determine longer-term impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 開放觀測數據集降低第三方在DeepMind天氣堆疊上建構的門檻。所聲稱降水技能提升的獨立驗證將決定長期影響。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are releasing two foundational datasets, SatWeave and PARDIG, to support the global community in building weather, hydrology, and climate applications.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們發布兩個基礎資料集 SatWeave 與 PARDIG，以支援全球社群建構天氣、水文與氣候應用。

items_flat.title_en: Meta introduces Muse Ember, a small efficient model for agentic workloads
items_flat.title_zh: Meta推出Muse Ember，專為agentic工作負載的小型高效模型
items_flat.summary_en: On November 9, Meta AI announced Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model to date, built for high-volume agentic tasks such as tool calls, coding subtasks, and long-document parsing. It is available on the Meta Model API at $0.10 per million input tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月9日，Meta AI宣布推出Muse Ember，其迄今最小且最高效的模型，專為高量agentic任務如工具呼叫、編碼子任務與長文件解析而建。可在Meta Model API以每百萬輸入token 0.10美元取得。
items_flat.analysis_en: Ember extends Meta’s Muse family into a low-cost, high-throughput tier, aiming at the economics of always-on agents. Claims of matching or beating Haiku 5.5 at one-third the cost need external confirmation.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Ember將Meta的Muse家族延伸至低成本、高吞吐量層級，瞄準永遠在線代理的經濟效益。以三分之一成本匹配或超越Haiku 5.5的聲稱需外部確認。
items_flat.quote: Today we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model, built for complex reasoning execution and everyday agent work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Muse Ember，我們最小且最高效的模型，專為複雜推理執行與日常代理工作而建。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic makes Claude Opus 5.5 the default model on paid plans and publishes knowledge-work guide
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic將Claude Opus 5.5設為付費方案預設模型並發布知識工作指南
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic set Claude Opus 5.5 as the default model on Pro, Max, Ultra, and Team plans and published a guide recommending it for daily knowledge work. The guide advises dropping phrases such as “think hard,” starting at Medium effort, and describing the desired outcome rather than the process.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic將Claude Opus 5.5設為Pro、Max、Ultra與Team方案的預設模型，並發布指南建議用於日常知識工作。指南建議捨棄「think hard」等用語，從Medium effort開始，並描述期望結果而非過程。
anthropic.analysis_en: Making a stronger model the default lowers the barrier for most users while the prompting guidance aims to avoid habits that under-use adaptive thinking. Whether the higher per-token cost is offset in practice is still early.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 將更強模型設為預設降低大多數用戶門檻，而提示指引旨在避免低估適應性思考的習慣。更高每token成本是否在實務中被抵消仍早。
anthropic.quote: Claude Opus 5.5 is now the default model in Claude on Pro, Max, Ultra, and Team plans. We recommend it as your daily driver for knowledge work.
anthropic.quote_zh: Claude Opus 5.5 現在是 Claude 在 Pro、Max、Ultra 與 Team 方案上的預設模型。我們推薦它作為知識工作的日常主力。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic adds experimental Code Mode to Claude Code for multi-tool calls in JavaScript
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic為Claude Code新增實驗性Code Mode，以JavaScript一次發出多工具呼叫
anthropic.summary_en: Claude Code v2.1.323 introduced experimental Code Mode, in which Claude writes JavaScript that issues multiple tool calls (Bash, Read, Edit, etc.) in one step and returns only the needed results. It is off by default and can be enabled via configuration.
anthropic.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.323引入實驗性Code Mode，Claude可撰寫JavaScript一次發出多個工具呼叫（Bash、Read、Edit等）並只回傳所需結果。預設關閉，可透過設定啟用。
anthropic.analysis_en: Code Mode targets the token cost of sequential tool calling, which is a practical bottleneck for long agentic sessions. Its experimental status and restrictions on certain features mean adoption will be gradual.
anthropic.analysis_zh: Code Mode針對順序工具呼叫的token成本，這是長時agentic會話的實務瓶頸。其實驗狀態與某些功能限制意味採用將逐步進行。
anthropic.quote: With Code Mode, Claude writes a piece of JavaScript that makes the tool calls, and Claude Code runs that code in your session.
anthropic.quote_zh: 啟用 Code Mode 後，Claude 會撰寫一段進行工具呼叫的 JavaScript，並由 Claude Code 在您的工作階段中執行該程式碼。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic publishes 10 recommendations for designing and reporting AI safety evaluations
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic發布設計與報告AI安全評估的10項建議
anthropic.summary_en: On November 13, Anthropic posted “Building Strong Safety Evaluations” on its engineering/research blog, offering 10 recommendations for how labs design, run, and report the evaluations that inform deployment and safeguard decisions.
anthropic.summary_zh: 11月13日，Anthropic在其工程/研究部落格發表「Building Strong Safety Evaluations」，提出10項建議，說明實驗室應如何設計、執行與報告影響部署與安全防護決策的評估。
anthropic.analysis_en: Public recommendations raise the floor for evaluation quality across the industry, especially around preregistration and multi-turn testing. Whether other labs adopt them in practice is uncertain.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 公開建議提升產業評估品質的下限，尤其在預註冊與多輪測試方面。其他實驗室是否實務採用仍不確定。
anthropic.quote: Safety evaluations inform some of the most consequential decisions we make about an AI model, including whether it’s ready to deploy, which safeguards ship alongside it, and what our next round of safety training and research should focus on.
anthropic.quote_zh: 安全評估影響我們對 AI 模型所做的一些最關鍵決定，包括是否準備好部署、隨之附帶哪些安全護欄，以及下一輪安全訓練與研究應聚焦何處。

google.title_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for faster everyday agentic workflows
google.title_zh: Google推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，加速日常agentic工作流程
google.summary_en: On November 12, Google DeepMind and Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, positioned as a fast, efficient model for coding and agentic workflows rather than the deepest long-horizon reasoning of Carbon or Argon. It is available across Gemini surfaces at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens with a 1M context window and claims 2.5× speed over 3.8 Flash.
google.summary_zh: 11月12日，Google DeepMind與Google推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，定位為編碼與agentic工作流程的快速高效模型，而非Carbon或Argon的最深長時推理。它已在Gemini各表面開放，價格每百萬token 1.50/7.50美元，1M上下文，宣稱比3.8 Flash快2.5倍。
google.analysis_en: Hydrogen broadens Gemini 4 access at a lower price point while claiming speed and efficiency gains over 3.8 Flash. It does not displace the higher-capability Carbon/Argon tier.
google.analysis_zh: Hydrogen以較低價格擴大Gemini 4的可及性，並宣稱在速度與效率上優於3.8 Flash。它並未取代更高能力的Carbon/Argon層級。
google.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，將前沿智能帶給所有人——以速度與效率支援日常編碼與agentic工作流程。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 for improved real-world dexterity
google.title_zh: Google DeepMind推出Gemini Robotics 2.5，提升真實世界靈巧度
google.summary_en: On November 10, Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action model that expands task breadth and learning speed. In a Mercedes-Benz proof-of-concept, Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid achieved a reported 96% success rate on automotive parts kitting.
google.summary_zh: 11月10日，Google DeepMind發布Gemini Robotics 2.5，這是擴展任務廣度與學習速度的視覺-語言-動作模型。在Mercedes-Benz概念驗證中，Apptronik的Apollo 2人形機器人在汽車零件組裝上報導達96%成功率。
google.analysis_en: The industrial pilot supplies a concrete reliability signal beyond lab benchmarks, yet the 96% figure is vendor-reported on a narrow workflow. Broader generalization and safety in unstructured settings remain open.
google.analysis_zh: 工業試點提供了超出實驗室基準的具體可靠性訊號，但96%數字是供應商在狹窄工作流程上的報導。更廣泛的泛化與非結構化環境安全性仍待觀察。
google.quote: During a real-world proof-of-concept on Mercedes-Benz production lines, our models helped Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid pick and pack automotive parts with a 96% success rate.
google.quote_zh: 在Mercedes-Benz生產線的真實概念驗證中，我們的模型幫助Apptronik的Apollo 2人形機器人揀選與包裝汽車零件，成功率達96%。

google.title_en: Google Research opens Antigravity /teamwork multi-agent tools and reports Lean formalizations of major math results
google.title_zh: Google Research開放Antigravity /teamwork多代理工具，並報告重大數學結果的Lean形式化
google.summary_en: On November 13, Google Research described results from Antigravity’s /teamwork multi-agent workflows using Gemini 4 models, including claimed machine-checked formalizations such as a full proof of the Courtade–Kumar conjecture and large Lean outputs.
google.summary_zh: 11月13日，Google Research描述了使用Gemini 4模型的Antigravity /teamwork多代理工作流程結果，包括聲稱的機器檢查形式化，如Courtade–Kumar猜想的完整證明與大型Lean輸出。
google.analysis_en: Opening multi-agent research orchestration to outsiders accelerates independent scrutiny of the claimed formalizations. The scale of the Lean outputs is notable, but independent verification is still required.
google.analysis_zh: 向外部開放多代理研究編排，加速對所聲稱形式化的獨立審查。Lean輸出的規模值得注意，但仍需獨立驗證。
google.quote: External scientists and developers can use Gemini 4 models with /teamwork and /boost in Antigravity and Deep Review today.
google.quote_zh: 外部科學家與開發者今日即可在 Antigravity 與 Deep Review 中使用 Gemini 4 模型搭配 /teamwork 與 /boost。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind releases PARDIG and SatWeave weather datasets
google.title_zh: Google DeepMind發布PARDIG與SatWeave天氣數據集
google.summary_en: On November 13, Google DeepMind released two foundational datasets used by WeatherNext 3: SatWeave (a global mosaic of geostationary satellite imagery) and PARDIG (an AI-based global precipitation dataset). Historical archives and live feeds are available.
google.summary_zh: 11月13日，Google DeepMind發布WeatherNext 3使用的兩個基礎數據集：SatWeave（地球靜止衛星影像全球拼接）與PARDIG（基於AI的全球降水數據集）。歷史檔案與即時饋送皆可用。
google.analysis_en: Open observational datasets lower the barrier for third parties to build on DeepMind’s weather stack. Independent validation of the claimed precipitation-skill gains will determine longer-term impact.
google.analysis_zh: 開放觀測數據集降低第三方在DeepMind天氣堆疊上建構的門檻。所聲稱降水技能提升的獨立驗證將決定長期影響。
google.quote: Today, we are releasing two foundational datasets, SatWeave and PARDIG, to support the global community in building weather, hydrology, and climate applications.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們發布兩個基礎資料集 SatWeave 與 PARDIG，以支援全球社群建構天氣、水文與氣候應用。

meta.title_en: Meta introduces Muse Ember, a small efficient model for agentic workloads
meta.title_zh: Meta推出Muse Ember，專為agentic工作負載的小型高效模型
meta.summary_en: On November 9, Meta AI announced Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model to date, built for high-volume agentic tasks such as tool calls, coding subtasks, and long-document parsing. It is available on the Meta Model API at $0.10 per million input tokens.
meta.summary_zh: 11月9日，Meta AI宣布推出Muse Ember，其迄今最小且最高效的模型，專為高量agentic任務如工具呼叫、編碼子任務與長文件解析而建。可在Meta Model API以每百萬輸入token 0.10美元取得。
meta.analysis_en: Ember extends Meta’s Muse family into a low-cost, high-throughput tier, aiming at the economics of always-on agents. Claims of matching or beating Haiku 5.5 at one-third the cost need external confirmation.
meta.analysis_zh: Ember將Meta的Muse家族延伸至低成本、高吞吐量層級，瞄準永遠在線代理的經濟效益。以三分之一成本匹配或超越Haiku 5.5的聲稱需外部確認。
meta.quote: Today we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model, built for complex reasoning execution and everyday agent work.
meta.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Muse Ember，我們最小且最高效的模型，專為複雜推理執行與日常代理工作而建。

brief_en: Anthropic’s Fable 5.2/Mythos 5.2 and IPO roadshow remain the day’s highest-signal items, alongside Google’s Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Robotics 2.5, OpenAI’s ChatGPT Wallet, and Meta’s Muse Ember. No new flagship releases in the last 12 hours.
brief_zh: 今日重點仍是Anthropic的Fable 5.2/Mythos 5.2與IPO路演，加上Google的Gemini 4 Hydrogen與Robotics 2.5、OpenAI的ChatGPT Wallet，以及Meta的Muse Ember。過去12小時無新旗艦模型發布。
